title: Hell Is Other Robots — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Behind Hell Is Other Robots sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. "Hell Is Other Robots" is the ninth episode in the  first season of the American animated television series Futurama. The episode was written by Eric Kaplan and directed by Rich Moore.

The nihilist does not deny Hell Is Other Robots — he only refuses to flatter it. Brian Cortis of The Age gave the episode a rating of three stars out of four. Writing in The Observer after Futurama's debut in the United States but before it aired in the United Kingdom, Andrew Collins wrote favorably of the series and highlighted "Hell Is Other Robots" and "Love's Labors Lost in Space".
